motivation: The original public nearest-target classifier was wrong with confidence 15/32; a retrospective response envelope could abstain but has no prospective guarantee. This is a follow-up method designed after observing initial ongoing pilot shards. It must be tested on a fully NEW seed cohort; never pool with pilot.

model_immutable_parameters.pilot_knowledge_disclosure: The separate first-prospective cohort 160101-160108 and 170101-170108 had already partially reported results before this hybrid method was proposed. This second experiment is an explicitly informed follow-up, not a fully blind independent confirmation of the research question.

hybrid_action_rule: Use only achieved pre- and post-one-native-zero-delta probe XYZ and both action-history computed hidden-target hypotheses
Unique candidate consistent with fixed historical empirical response error envelope => carry this candidate forward with ZERO authoritative target reads
Two candidates consistent OR neither consistent => issue EXACTLY ONE authoritative controller-target read at the probe boundary and resume with returned target
Never reinterpret true execution-truth label as a decision input; stop/abstain if privileged read is unavailable
Same source actor, controller chart, native probe intervention, gripper, horizon and seed as the mandatory-query arm
claim_limits: Not an externally attested safety response model and no guarantee of zero false history labels
Original physical manipulations only official ManiSkill Panda controller, no real hardware
One native arm control may physically alter future contact trajectories even if hidden state classified correctly
Third party validation and academic reviewer adoption remain unproven
